    Linear realizations of mesh categories #

    An assignment of objects and reversed arrow representatives determines a linear functor from the free path category. If the displayed mesh relations evaluate to zero, that functor descends to the mesh quotient. This file also isolates the exact kernel statement which makes the descended realization faithful.
